_comment: autoDQM isolation-forest pipeline — central configuration. All paths are absolute so the file works from Condor worker nodes, cron jobs, or any working directory. CLI arguments always override these values.
_comment_input: Run lists: text files where each line is a glob pattern resolving to Digitizer CSV files. data_path is the base directory; the individual lists are absolute paths derived from it.
_comment_output: model_tag namespaces all outputs: models/<tag>/, logs/<tag>.csv, reports/<tag>/, plots/<tag>/.
_comment_features: Feature set flags. use_trigger includes TriggerBoard rate features; use_lvds includes LVDS pin-count features. ignore_features is a list of glob patterns for features to exclude entirely from training and scoring (e.g. 'TDCRollovers_*' drops TDCRollovers_mean/std/median).
_comment_thresholds: z_threshold: number of standard deviations above which a channel feature is flagged. if_contamination: expected fraction of anomalies in training data passed to IsolationForest. file_alert_n_channels: number of anomalous channels required to classify a file as ALERT (exactly 1 → WARN).
_comment_misc: poll_interval: seconds between directory scans in watch mode. test_seed: random seed for reproducible test-mode file sampling.
